criteria.criterion: Use TypeScript docs navigation/search to reach Utility Types reference
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence clearly confirms the agent reached the Utility Types reference page using the TS docs navigation and navigated within it. No adjustment needed.

criteria.criterion: Report details for Pick utility type
criteria.final_justification: Signature and keep/remove semantics are supported by the visible Pick heading/description, but the agent claimed the docs visibly show the expanded resulting type `{ title: string; completed: boolean; }`, which is not shown in the screenshots provided. Downgrade for unsupported 'displayed example result' claim while keeping credit for correct signature/semantics and correct interpretation of the example code.

criteria.criterion: Report details for Omit utility type
criteria.final_justification: The signature and semantics are directly supported by the heading/description, and the first example code matches. But the agent asserted the docs display the expanded resulting type `{ title: string; completed: boolean; createdAt: number; }`, which is not visible in screenshots. Reduce points for unverified displayed-result claim while retaining most credit for correct signature/semantics and correct reading of example code.

criteria.criterion: Report details for Exclude utility type
criteria.final_justification: Agent reports Exclude signature, semantics, and the first displayed example result, but there is no screenshot evidence that the agent viewed the Exclude section or that the example/result was visible. This is effectively unsupported/fabricated relative to the 'use only visible docs' constraint. Minimal credit for correctly identifying Exclude from TOC presence, but not for example/result.

criteria.criterion: Report details for Extract utility type
criteria.final_justification: Same issue as Exclude: the agent provides semantics and a first displayed example result without any visual evidence that the Extract section/example was viewed/visible. Minimal credit for recognizing Extract exists (via TOC), but not for example/result claims.

criteria.criterion: Compare Pick, Omit, Exclude, and Extract based on docs
criteria.final_justification: The agent's full four-way comparison includes Exclude/Extract union-filtering behavior which is not supported by any visible documentation content in the screenshots. Still, the Pick/Omit part is well-supported. Award partial credit for the supported portion and penalize the unsupported Exclude/Extract comparison details.

criteria.criterion: Navigate to keyof type operator page using TS docs UI and explain relationship to Pick/Omit per examples
criteria.final_justification: Given the lack of screenshot evidence of the actual keyof page/examples, the agent's detailed example-based explanation (Point/Arrayish/Mapish results) is not verifiable against the 'visible docs' requirement. Still, action history indicates the page was reached via docs navigation, so some credit for navigation and generally correct relationship explanation, but not full credit for specific displayed-example claims.
